title: Sentry Replay captures page text and media without masking
reasoning: The client enables Sentry Replay with maskAllText:false and blockAllMedia:false, so replay sessions can include rendered user/session text and media. The included tests demonstrate authenticated user input and service/session messages are part of normal UI flows, so this can send potentially sensitive user-input and session content to a third-party telemetry service.
recommendation: Use privacy-preserving Replay defaults for production, at minimum maskAllText:true and blockAllMedia:true, and selectively unmask only fields that have been reviewed as non-sensitive.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The tests exercise UI behavior and authentication flows but do not assert telemetry privacy configuration or inspect Sentry Replay options.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an entry-client/Sentry configuration test or a small exported Sentry config helper test that asserts Replay is initialized with text masking and media blocking enabled for production-like environments.
minimumFixScope: Change the Sentry replayIntegration options in app/entry-client.tsx and add a focused configuration test if the setup can be factored for testability.
